dischargeBlocks.title: Withhold water for 2 hours
dischargeBlocks.text: Withhold water for 2 hours to allow the Cerenia injection time to prevent vomiting.

dischargeBlocks.title: Withhold food
dischargeBlocks.text: Withhold food for {duration} to allow the stomach and intestinal inflammation to lessen. It is OK to hide pills in a small treat during the fasting period if needed.

dischargeBlocks.title: Offer small meals / bland diet
dischargeBlocks.text: Offer very small meals of a bland diet until no vomiting for 3 days, then transition back to the regular diet over 2 to 3 days.

dischargeBlocks.title: Bland diet options
dischargeBlocks.text:
PRESCRIPTION DIETS: Hill's i/d (i/d turkey = 384 cal/can, i/d stew = 264 cal/can; i/d dry ~350 cal/cup, i/d low fat = 300 cal/cup) or Purina EN.

HOME COOKED: 3 parts white rice to 1 part chicken — 1.25 cups per 10 lb per day. White rice 200–240 cal/cup; diced chicken (no skin or bones) 270–330 cal/cup. May substitute lean ground beef (93% lean, 330 cal/cup) or non-fat cottage cheese (123 cal/cup).

dischargeBlocks.title: Giving medications
dischargeBlocks.text: It is OK to hide pills in a small treat or pill pocket. If any medication causes vomiting or {name} refuses food, please call us before continuing.

dischargeBlocks.title: Follow up
dischargeBlocks.text: Please give us a call tomorrow morning to let us know how {name} is coming along. If any further vomiting occurs — especially if {name} is unable to hold down water — please call us right away or schedule an appointment, as we will probably need to see {name} again for re-evaluation and fluid administration. Vomiting pets can quickly become dehydrated, and vomiting that does not resolve quickly can indicate something more serious is occurring (such as pancreatitis or an intestinal obstruction).
